l1_connect_account.title: Onboard the environments that send no logs
l1_connect_account.why: The environment is in scope, but no logs arrive from it, so nothing that happens there can be detected.
steps: Name the owner of the environment and the person who can enable log export.
Turn on the audit log export and point it at the collector.
Check that events arrive and that the source shows as healthy.
l1_connect_account.success: Every environment in scope sends logs and shows healthy.
